### What is your dementia care program, and why does it stand out in Millburn?

Dementia care is what our community and referral partners know us for. Many of our Care Pros are dually certified as CHHAs and Certified Dementia Practitioners (CDPs) through the National Council of Certified Dementia Practitioners (NCCDP) — a nationally recognized certification requiring 150 hours of advanced training. Our CDP program is funded by a Department of Labor grant, which is what makes this level of specialized training possible at the scale we offer.

In practice, CDP-trained Care Pros are equipped to take a person-centered approach — reading nonverbal cues, anticipating unmet needs before they escalate, and maintaining dignity through even the most challenging moments. When a client with severe dementia was expressing increasing agitation, a Care Pro brought a cupcake and a candle on her birthday. The music of 'Happy Birthday' lit her up — from that day, the Care Pro built joy into every visit, and the agitation eased.

### How does your office engage with the Millburn community?

We sponsor local events through Explore MSH and the Millburn Chamber of Commerce. We also facilitate the Virtual Dementia Tour for community partners — a training program that simulates the experience of living with dementia, giving participants invaluable insight into what their clients and loved ones experience.
We sponsor lectures for older adults at the JCC and provide resource guidance to any family in the community navigating a care decision, whether or not they become clients.
